claims.text: An alert occurs when model probability is greater than or equal to 0.1428558780357408 (approximately 14.29%).
A below-threshold result does not rule out an event.
DIAL-ALERT uses the selected Step 4 random-forest model to estimate the probability of later-session systolic blood pressure below 90 mmHg.
